answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cipher holds work receipts rather than names, so the sonnet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
